title: Production Build + UI Quality

build_optimizations.code_splitting: Manual chunks configured in vite.config.ts (vendor, health)
build_optimizations.sourcemaps: Inline in development, disabled in production

ui_quality.design_system_preserved: Liquid-glass visual language, morph transitions, dark mode
ui_quality.responsive_design: CSS Grid/Flexbox with Tailwind responsive classes
ui_quality.animations: CSS keyframes for pulse, fade-in, shimmer, bar-fill, scanline
ui_quality.accessibility: ARIA labels, semantic HTML, focus-visible outlines, reduced motion support
ui_quality.performance: Lazy loading via code splitting, skeleton loaders, virtualized lists (planned)

assets.fonts: Inter (UI) + JetBrains Mono (monospace) via Google Fonts

environment_config.production: FIGMA_PUBLIC_URL for base path, VITE_API_BASE_URL for API
environment_config.proxy: Vite dev server proxies /api to localhost:8000

known_limitations: Attendance, Person, Timetable, Enrollment, Excel, Parent APIs not yet implemented on backend
Mock data used in stores for development
Video stream integration not implemented (CameraCard shows simulated feed)
WebRTC/HLS player not integrated for AnnotatedReplay
Excel import/export backend endpoints not implemented
Telegram link code workflow not implemented on backend
